title: Agent Observer Continuation Prompt
description: Wake prompt template. One-line, sent on each Stop event to resume observation.

wakeTemplate.const:
Transcript updated. Path: {transcriptPath}
Total lines: {totalLines}. Your last read position: line {lastLine}. Analyze new content since then.

initTemplate.const:
New session started. Transcript: {transcriptPath}
Total lines: {totalLines}. Observe and analyze.

noTranscriptTemplate.const: New session started. Session ID: {sessionId}. No transcript available yet.
